QuestInfo.parent: A Gift for a Citizen of Honor
QuestInfo.name: A Box Hidden Long Ago
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p221# of #m10001000# has something to tell me now that I've become a #bCitizen of Honor#k.
QuestInfo.1: #p221# of #m10001000# said there was a gift prepared for me for becoming a #bCitizen of Honor#k, but that she'd give it to me if I could do her one favor first. She told me that a long, long time ago, she'd hidden a small box containing a bow somewhere in #bthe Golem's Temple#k, but when she recently went to retrieve it, it was gone — and she asked me to go find that box for her. I wonder if #b#o48##k or #b#o49##k out there might have it.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: Why would #p221# have hidden this box in a place like that, I wonder?

0.0: The reason I wanted to see you was that I wanted to give you a gift for becoming a #bCitizen of Honor#k of #m10001000#. But before that... if you could grant me one small favor, I'd be happy to give you the gift afterward. What do you say?

yes.0: Thank you. This is a rather personal matter, and you're the only one I could think to ask. A long, long time ago, I hid something away in a box, somewhere. But when I went back there recently, the box was gone.
yes.1: Looking at the traces left behind, it seemed quite likely to have been the work of the monsters in that area. Still, I couldn't afford to be away for long, so I had no choice but to come back. I was hoping you might find that box for me in my stead.
yes.2: The place I hid the box is #bthe Golem's Temple#k. I believe either #b#o48##k or #b#o49##k there might have it. I do hope you'll be able to find it. I'm counting on you.

no.0: I see. It's quite a predicament, since you're the only one I can think to ask.

1.0: Oh, you're back. This... yes, this is the box I hid away. I'm glad I decided to ask you, after all. Shall we open it, just for a moment...?

item.0: I was hoping you could find the box I hid away in #bthe Golem's Temple#k long ago. I believe either #b#o48##k or #b#o49##k there might have it. I'm counting on you.
